steps.instruction: In a large bowl, add 1 1/4 cups of water to 1 2/3 cups of falafel mix.
Let the mix stand for 15 minutes before shaping it.
steps.spoken: Let the mix stand for 15 minutes, so it takes up the water.

steps.instruction: Place the balls into mini-cupcake tins or onto a cookie sheet.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a pan to 375 °F.
Fry the balls in the hot oil for 3 minutes, until brown and crisp.
steps.spoken: Fry the balls in the hot oil for about 3 minutes, until they are brown and crisp.

steps.instruction: Drain the falafel balls and set them aside.
Put 1 chopped head of red leaf lettuce, 3 tomatoes and 1 cucumber in a bowl.
Toss the vegetables with the falafel balls.
Douse the salad with 1/2 cup of tahini yogurt sauce.
steps.spoken: Douse the salad with 1/2 cup of tahini yogurt sauce. The falafel may be cold or hot.
